name: multi-ca-permit-for-unused-name-form-valid
description: An intermediate that adds a permittedSubtrees entry for a name form not present in the leaf SAN does not invalidate the chain. Per RFC 5280 4.2.1.10, name-constraint restrictions apply only when the specified name form is present in the leaf, and per RFC 5280 6.1.4(g)(1), the permitted_subtrees state for a name form is unchanged when a later certificate's permittedSubtrees does not include that form. Here the root permits DNS only, the intermediate permits IP only, and the leaf has only a DNS SAN inside the DNS permit - the IP permit is irrelevant because there is no IP SAN to check, and the DNS permit is unchanged because the intermediate has no DNS entry.
notes: Replaces the earlier `multi-ca-cross-type-intersection-empty-invalid` chain, which had the same shape but the wrong expected verdict. Cross-type permits do NOT intersect to an empty set across the chain; each name form is tracked independently.
